archetypes.name: resume-state
archetypes.rationale: Diff adds a complex resume state machine where precedence mistakes can route to unsafe phases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect resume classification precedence, branch validation, main/master guard behavior, and fresh/open-pr/merged/done routing. Look for paths where corrupt or stale state can bypass the intended safe-refuse or GitHub-authoritative checks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: github-pr
archetypes.rationale: Normal-repo resume now depends on GitHub PR state and head-ref matching.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review how gh.pr_view results, exceptions, PR numbers, PR URLs, and head_ref are integrated into resume routing. Check whether OPEN, MERGED, CLOSED, wrong-head, forked, and repo-unavailable cases follow the plan without trusting stale local state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: state-file
archetypes.rationale: The driver reads and writes shell-compatible state values across invocations.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine state-file parsing, validation, preservation, and writes for injection risks, path confusion, newline handling, malformed values, and accidental erasure of continuation markers. Pay special attention to branch names, repo slugs, PR URLs, conflict file lists, tmpdir scoping, and shell-state serialization. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: counter-limits
archetypes.rationale: Retry counters and cap semantics are threaded through many handback and terminal paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace iteration, rebase_count, fix_attempts, and transient_retries from resume read through monitor calls, terminal handbacks, rebase paths, and state writes. Look for off-by-one cap behavior, consumed increments not persisted, or non-fresh writes that reset counters to zero. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: postmerge-idem
archetypes.rationale: Merged, postmerge, and done idempotency changed across fresh and resumed flows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the merged-resume, done-resume, main CI success, and postmerge handling paths as a lifecycle. Verify that done is written only after successful postmerge, non-OK postmerge preserves retryable state, and repeated invocations remain idempotent without masking failures. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: oos-skip
archetypes.rationale: Open-PR resume intentionally bypasses checks, postbump, and OOS helpers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether open-PR resume skips only the intended pre-PR/OOS work while still preserving required side effects, context hydration, final-report behavior, and PR-only exits. Check for regressions where fresh paths skip required gates or resumed paths accidentally invoke helpers that can rewrite counters or state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
